enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Close eyes. Breathe steadily. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up to chin. Adjust pillow under head. Turn to right side. Kick off blanket. Pull blanket back over legs. Turn onto back. Snore. Move arm. Turn to left side again. Pull blanket up. Sleep.

Wake up. Sit up on bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Wash face with water. Pick up towel. Dry face. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Take out bread. Close refrigerator. Place items on counter. Open cupboard. Take out bowl. Take out plate. Close cupboard. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Pick up spoon. Eat cereal. Drink milk. Pick up plate. Put bread on plate. Eat bread. Wipe mouth with napkin. Pick up bowl. Put in sink.

Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Take out socks. Close wardrobe. Take off pajama top. Take off pajama bottoms. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Stand in front of mirror. Comb hair. Pick up bag. Put phone in bag. Pick up keys. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Check phone. Board bus. Tap card on reader. Find seat. Sit down. Hold handrail. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk to workplace building. Enter building. Walk to elevator. Press button. Wait for elevator. Enter elevator. Press floor button. Exit elevator. Walk to office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at office. Clock in. Put on uniform. Wash hands. Check schedule. Attend morning meeting. See patient 1. Take vitals. Administer medication. Update patient record. See patient 2. Draw blood. Label sample. Send to lab. Take lunch break. Eat sandwich. Return to work. See patient 3. Change bandage. Consult with doctor. Update records. End shift. Clock out.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Check phone. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit. Hold handrail. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk home. Enter home.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out chicken. Close refrigerator. Place on counter. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add chicken. Stir. Add vegetables. Stir. Turn off stove. Take plate. Serve food. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Clear table. Wash dishes.

Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Press channel button. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Change channel. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Watch TV. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Get snack. Walk back. Sit on sofa. Continue watching TV.

Sit at desk. Open laptop. Press power button. Wait for boot. Type password. Open browser. Read news. Scroll down. Click link. Read article. Open email. Reply to email. Close browser. Open document. Type report. Save document. Close laptop. Pick up book. Open book. Read pages. Turn page. Close book.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Adjust water temperature. Take off clothes. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Scrub body. Rinse body. Wash hair. Rinse hair. Turn off water. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Put on pajamas. Brush teeth. Turn off light. Walk out.

Walk to bedroom. Turn on TV. Sit on bed. Watch TV. Change channel. Adjust volume. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Pick up book. Open book. Read. Turn page. Close book. Put down book. Lie down on bed. Pull blanket up. Close eyes.

Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Kick off blanket. Pull blanket back. Turn on back. Snore. Move arm. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Sleep.
